levelNote: A 45-minute written paper plus three practical case studies requiring full forensic reports — the practicals carry the weight, not the paper. Long established in law enforcement. Below CFCE, which gates on a four-month mentored peer review on top of its practicals. No training weight: the ISFCE course is one route in, but documented experience is an alternative.
prerequisites: 18 months of forensic examination experience, or ISFCE training
name: CCE

cost.note: Exam fee. ISFCE training is priced separately.
